Keep broad empty space around the character to emphasize solitude; no readable signs.
STREET: Vietnamese coastal fishing town main road between the crossroad and fish market: weathered asphalt dusted with sea sand, low salt-bleached concrete houses with corrugated tin awnings and overhead utility wires, Ông Bảy's sidewalk coffee stall beside the stone sea wall with distant wooden fishing boats on the sea.

scenes.title: Ngày Thứ Nhất
scenes.purpose: Sơn tới Hòn Sóng và tự đặt hạn chờ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Let the porch sea wind fall under rain on the silk-shop awning. Cut to the existing silk curtain, not to another coach arrival.

clips.start_frame: Coach door open on the cracked coastal road; Sơn stands inside on the lower step, the single weathered dark-olive canvas backpack slung over his left shoulder with his left hand gripping its shoulder strap.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: Sơn steps down completely from the open coach doorway onto the dusty cracked asphalt road once; the single weathered dark-olive canvas backpack remains slung over his left shoulder with his left hand gripping its shoulder strap. 2.5–6.5s: The coach pulls away and exits the frame while Sơn stands still in the coastal wind, his eyes fixed on the departing vehicle as his jaw tightens almost imperceptibly with a brief trace of regret. 6.5–10.0s: Sơn takes one controlled breath, turns toward the coastal fishing town with cold, determined eyes, and begins stepping forward as fine dust moves naturally around his worn boots.
clips.end_frame: Sơn standing alone at the coastal crossroad facing town and beginning to step forward, the single dark-olive canvas backpack slung over his left shoulder with his left hand gripping its strap.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm miền Nam điềm tĩnh, từng trải, ngắt nhịp rõ từng câu ngắn chuẩn 1.0x
dialogue.text: Tôi là Sơn. Giang hồ gọi tôi là Bóng Ma. Rắn Đen bắt Hạ rồi. Tôi chỉ còn bảy ngày để đưa cô ấy về.

clips.lighting: Light sea mist, cool blue-grey coastal dawn fill blended with pale warm early morning sunlight (sương biển nhẹ, ánh sáng xanh lạnh pha vàng nhạt của bình minh), no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Make arrival feel like a deliberate loss of escape, not a travel postcard.
cinematic.composition: Keep the coach on the left side of the frame and wide empty space toward the coastal fishing town on the right, preserving negative space and isolation.
cinematic.blocking: 0.0–2.5s: Sơn steps down from the coach completely once. 2.5–6.5s: the coach departs as Sơn stands watching. 6.5–10.0s: Sơn shifts his gaze toward town and begins stepping forward. The single canvas backpack remains slung over his left shoulder throughout; no additional bag.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's expression is restrained and battle-worn. His jaw tightens almost imperceptibly as the coach departs. His eyes remain fixed on the disappearing vehicle, showing a brief trace of regret. He takes one controlled breath, then turns toward town with cold, determined eyes. No exaggerated sadness, no theatrical frown, no forced hero pose.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn and the coach edge readable in the established wide depth.
cinematic.texture: Fine dust moves naturally around worn boots; jacket fabric lifts only with sea wind.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine weight recedes continuously into exposed sea wind; narration remains dry and close.
cinematic.rhythm: 0.0–2.5s complete step-down; 2.5–6.5s stillness as coach departs; 6.5–10.0s controlled breath, turn and first step toward town.

clips.wardrobe_note: The single weathered dark-olive canvas backpack remains slung over Sơn's left shoulder throughout the entire shot. His left hand grips its shoulder strap. Closed silver pocket watch chained in his right jacket pocket. No additional bag.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu bạc màu, đi giày cổ thấp sờn cũ; chiếc ba lô vải bố màu ô liu sẫm duy nhất luôn đeo trên vai trái xuyên suốt cảnh, bàn tay trái nắm chắc dây đeo vai ba lô (tuyệt đối không có túi xách thứ hai), túi áo phải cất đồng hồ quả quýt bạc đóng nắp.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Không gian cố định: KHÓA KHÔNG GIAN CẢNH 01 (Trục bờ biển Hòn Sóng — Ngã ba, Quán Ông Bảy & Chòi gỗ đồi dương): Cố định trục không gian bình minh ven biển kéo từ điểm dừng xe đò (phía bắc) qua quán cà phê mái bạt xanh của Ông Bảy sát bờ kè (trung tâm) lên lối cát rặng dương tới căn chòi gỗ một gian và hiên nam nhìn ra biển. Ánh sáng bình minh lạnh pha nắng sớm hướng đông giữ nguyên từ Clip 1 đến Clip 6. · Bối cảnh nhánh: Ngã ba đường ven biển Hòn Sóng (trạm dừng xe đò) (D1 dawn) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Anamorphic Wide, f/5.6) — khóa toàn bộ không gian cố định, trục 180 độ và vị trí nhân vật. Vào hình ở 0.0s xoay quanh hệ vật thể cố định của cảnh (VẬT THỂ CỐ ĐỊNH XUYÊN SUỐT CẢNH 01 (Clip 1–6): (1) Ba lô vải bố màu ô liu sẫm sờn cũ của Sơn; (2) Đồng hồ quả quýt bạc khắc hoa luôn đóng nắp; (3) Thùng nhựa đựng cá và chìa khóa đồng của Ông Bảy; (4) Khung cửa gỗ căn chòi và con dao khắc nhỏ (khắc vạch thứ 1 ở Clip 5). Tuyệt đối không phát sinh hành lý hay vật thể lạ.).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s — Khóa góc quay & Vật thể cố định): Góc máy toàn cảnh (35mm anamorphic wide, f/5.6) — khóa toàn bộ không gian cố định, trục 180 độ và vị trí nhân vật tại ngã ba đường ven biển hòn sóng (trạm dừng xe đò), nhân vật vào nhịp chuyển động ngay từ khung hình đầu tiên, chỉ tương tác xung quanh hệ vật thể cố định (WATCH, BACKPACK). Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s — Giọng nói & Câu thoại chuẩn tự nhiên 1.0x): Bắt đầu lời thoại từ giây 0.3s với nhịp độ chuẩn tự nhiên, rõ chữ, đúng chất giọng và cảm xúc nhân vật (SON (giọng nam trầm miền Nam điềm tĩnh, từng trải, ngắt nhịp rõ từng câu ngắn chuẩn 1.0x): "Tôi là Sơn. Giang hồ gọi tôi là Bóng Ma. Rắn Đen bắt Hạ rồi. Tôi chỉ còn bảy ngày để đưa cô ấy về."), kết hợp thao tác tay với vật dụng cố định và giữ đúng trục máy 180 độ. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s — Điểm bẻ & Khóa khung kết): Đẩy căng phản ứng tâm lý theo mục tiêu cảnh (Sơn tới Hòn Sóng và tự đặt hạn chờ), giữ nguyên vị trí các vật thể cố định trong cảnh và dừng đúng hướng nhìn ở giây 10.0s để nối mượt sang cú máy tiếp theo.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế nhân vật và giữ nguyên hệ vật thể cố định (WATCH, BACKPACK) trong không gian cố định tại giây 10.0s, chuyển động môi trường tiếp diễn tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Anamorphic Wide, f/5.6) — khóa toàn bộ không gian cố định, trục 180 độ và vị trí nhân vật · Mã vật thể cố định trong khung: WATCH, BACKPACK.

clips.start_frame: Sơn approaching the coffee stall from screen left, the single dark-olive canvas backpack slung over Sơn's left shoulder.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Sơn approaching the coffee stall from screen left), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation, the single dark-olive canvas backpack slung over Sơn's left shoulder. 2.5–6.5s: He catches a crate rolling toward the road and returns it to Bảy (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: He treats the recovery as routine; Bảy's surprise softens into curiosity rather than gratitude theatre, settling into the end state (Bảy holds the recovered crate, Sơn beside the stall) as scuffed crate corners and sun-faded awning establish a working town rather than a polished set.

clips.lighting: Light sea mist, cool blue-grey coastal dawn fill blended with pale warm early morning sunlight (sương biển nhẹ, ánh sáng xanh lạnh pha vàng nhạt của bình minh), no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Earn Bảy's later kindness through an ordinary helpful act, without making Sơn heroic.
cinematic.composition: Track at pedestrian height with the road edge and rolling crate visible together.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn intercepts the crate within his walking line, returns it, then stops beside Bảy.
cinematic.performance: He treats the recovery as routine; Bảy's surprise softens into curiosity rather than gratitude theatre.
cinematic.focus: Favor the returning crate and both upper bodies; keep the road legible behind.
cinematic.texture: Scuffed crate corners and sun-faded awning establish a working town rather than a polished set.
cinematic.sound_detail: One scrape, restrained footfall and Bảy's breath precede his thanks; no triumphant accent.
cinematic.rhythm: Let catch and return form one continuous motion, then allow the question to land.

clips.wardrobe_note: The single weathered dark-olive canvas backpack remains slung over Sơn's left shoulder throughout the entire shot. No additional bag. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder at the coffee stall.

dialogue.text: Trên đồi dương sau quán có căn chòi gỗ trống, nhìn rõ hết đường.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn choosing isolation while Bảy offers practical shelter without demanding a confession.
cinematic.composition: Frame the counter as a modest boundary, both faces readable in the medium setup.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn stays on the customer side; Bảy's pointing hand opens the route toward the dune.
cinematic.performance: Sơn asks quietly without selling a cover story; Bảy answers from habit, not suspicion.
cinematic.focus: Hold both eyelines and the pointing hand at a usable shared depth.
cinematic.texture: Condensation on existing glasses and weathered counter grain give the exchange everyday weight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep low stall ambience below the line; let the sea remain present but unromantic.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow the question and Bảy's pointing response to land at a natural, unhurried coastal pace.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.tone: giọng ông lão miền biển ấm áp, hơi thở nhẹ sau khi leo dốc cát

dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm chắc gọn, đón chìa khóa bằng sự trân trọng kín đáo

cinematic.intent: Make receiving the key feel like accepting a temporary place, not finding safety.
cinematic.composition: Keep cabin, last stretch of path and the two men in the same wide geography.
cinematic.blocking: They finish the climb before the key passes into Sơn's open right palm.
cinematic.performance: Bảy is lightly winded and matter-of-fact; Sơn receives without the ease of a vacationer.
cinematic.focus: Maintain readable figures and the handover zone; do not cut to a separate key insert.
cinematic.texture: Pine shadows cross the sand; the small metal key looks used rather than ceremonial.
cinematic.sound_detail: Retain their breathing under the pine wind; Bảy's dry joke should not invite a music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Pace the final steps up the sand path and the key handover with natural breathing and weight.

cinematic.intent: Turn a vague stay into an exact private deadline that the audience cannot yet explain.
cinematic.composition: Use the existing detail angle on tool, clean wood and the newly cut single mark.
cinematic.blocking: His hand makes only the first short tally, then lowers the tool completely from the mark.
cinematic.performance: Express the decision through a steady wrist and controlled pressure, not a violent flourish.
cinematic.focus: Keep the cut and adjacent untouched grain sharp; the room remains unimportant beyond.
cinematic.texture: Fresh pale wood contrasts with the dark old frame; a few loose fibers catch daylight.
cinematic.sound_detail: One brief wood scrape sits beneath the voice-over; no clock tick is added here.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow recognition of the first mark before the tool leaves, while wind keeps the image alive.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated on the porch with his closed watch.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng độc thoại trầm ấm, nén chặt nỗi đau bên tiếng sóng biển
dialogue.text: Chiếc đồng hồ bạc của Hạ đã ngừng chạy từ đêm phục kích. Chưa đưa được cô ấy về, tôi sẽ không mở nắp.

clips.lighting: Light sea mist, cool blue-grey coastal dawn fill blended with pale warm early morning sunlight (sương biển nhẹ, ánh sáng xanh lạnh pha vàng nhạt của bình minh), no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Attach the closed watch to a withheld emotional truth rather than explaining its contents.
cinematic.composition: Keep the watch at chest-to-lap height inside the medium frame, sea soft beyond his shoulder.
cinematic.blocking: He rotates the engraved lid into existing light without touching the release clasp.
cinematic.performance: His face should resist tears; one contained breath carries more weight than a mournful stare.
cinematic.focus: Share useful focus between his fingers and face, never revealing the hidden watch interior.
cinematic.texture: Worn silver catches a narrow natural glint; jacket cuffs and salt air remain tactile.
cinematic.sound_detail: The watch is silent in the present; only porch wood, wind and his breathing remain.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the small rotation finish, then stay on the consequence without a second turn.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

dialogue.tone: giọng quý bà miền Nam ngọt lạnh, uy quyền ẩn sau vẻ hiền từ

cinematic.intent: Introduce a household invitation whose geometry already limits Sơn's freedom to leave.
cinematic.composition: Keep Bà Hai behind the desk and Dũng near the rear door within one wide frame.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn stops at the desk edge while Dũng closes the door softly behind his path.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai's warmth is practiced and genuine enough to unsettle; Dũng avoids a theatrical glare.
cinematic.focus: Keep all three positions legible, with the door not swallowed by excessive blur.
cinematic.texture: Silk absorbs the warm lamp light while the desk retains a hard reflective edge.
cinematic.sound_detail: Door latch is quiet but distinct; her invitation stays conversational, without a sinister sting.
cinematic.rhythm: Snap the rear door shut and deliver the invitation immediately to establish brisk, tight room control.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop. Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder.

clips.start_frame: Bà Hai's left hand beside a face-down photograph.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Bà Hai's left hand beside a face-down photograph), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: She slides Kiên's portrait toward Sơn, jade bracelet visible (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: The hand is brisk and assumes compliance; his glove remains still long enough to register refusal, settling into the end state (Kiên's portrait beside Sơn's black glove) as jade and paper move against polished wood; the glove's matte leather interrupts both reflections.
clips.end_frame: Kiên's portrait beside Sơn's black glove.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ trầm quyền uy, chậm rãi và áp đặt từ phía bàn trà
dialogue.text: Vũ Kiên đang nắm cuốn sổ gốc của đường dây. Má cần con lấy lại nó trong chuyến cuối cùng này.

clips.lighting: Night interior, warm desk lamp and shop practicals, wet alley beyond.

cinematic.intent: Let a single sliding photograph define the transaction more clearly than exposition can.
cinematic.composition: Place the bracelet, portrait and Sơn's black glove within the same stable detail plane.
cinematic.blocking: Her left hand slides the photograph toward his glove and stops before touching him.
cinematic.performance: The hand is brisk and assumes compliance; his glove remains still long enough to register refusal.
cinematic.focus: Keep the photographed face readable as a picture, not an extra living person in the room.
cinematic.texture: Jade and paper move against polished wood; the glove's matte leather interrupts both reflections.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Không gian cố định: KHÓA KHÔNG GIAN CẢNH 04 (Bên trong tiệm hoa của Hạ tại thành phố): Cố định duy nhất một gian tiệm hoa xuyên suốt 6 clip: quầy gỗ gói hoa bên tường đông, dãy xô thiếc cắm hoa ly trắng dưới khung cửa kính lớn (phía nam) nhìn thẳng sang sảnh tòa tháp của Vũ Kiên bên kia đường, và chiếc ghế gỗ nhỏ sát cửa sổ. · Bối cảnh nhánh: Tiệm hoa tươi của Hạ tại thành phố (PAST one month earlier afternoon) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh ngang thắt lưng (50mm Standard Prime, f/4.0) — khóa tương tác tay, đạo cụ và ánh mắt đối thoại tự nhiên. screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s — Khóa góc quay & Vật thể cố định): Góc máy trung cảnh ngang thắt lưng (50mm standard prime, f/4.0) — khóa tương tác tay, đạo cụ và ánh mắt đối thoại tự nhiên tại tiệm hoa tươi của hạ tại thành phố, nhân vật vào nhịp chuyển động ngay từ khung hình đầu tiên, chỉ tương tác xung quanh hệ vật thể cố định (LILY). Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s — Giọng nói & Câu thoại chuẩn tự nhiên 1.0x): Bắt đầu lời thoại từ giây 0.3s với nhịp độ chuẩn tự nhiên, rõ chữ, đúng chất giọng và cảm xúc nhân vật (SON_P (giọng nam trầm phản xạ nhanh, ân cần hỏi thăm): "Tôi mua cho người chưa từng nhận hoa. Tay cô coi chừng mảnh vỡ kìa." — HA (giọng nữ nhẹ nhõm, ánh mắt ngạc nhiên ấm áp): "May nhờ anh chụp kịp, phản xạ nhanh vậy chắc không phải dân văn phòng."), kết hợp thao tác tay với vật dụng cố định và giữ đúng trục máy 180 độ. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s — Điểm bẻ & Khóa khung kết): Đẩy căng phản ứng tâm lý theo mục tiêu cảnh (Tình cảm nảy từ hành vi cụ thể qua ba lần gặp), giữ nguyên vị trí các vật thể cố định trong cảnh và dừng đúng hướng nhìn ở giây 10.0s để nối mượt sang cú máy tiếp theo.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế nhân vật và giữ nguyên hệ vật thể cố định (LILY) trong không gian cố định tại giây 10.0s, chuyển động môi trường tiếp diễn tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh ngang thắt lưng (50mm Standard Prime, f/4.0) — khóa tương tác tay, đạo cụ và ánh mắt đối thoại tự nhiên · Mã vật thể cố định trong khung: LILY.

clips.start_frame: Same window chair on the following afternoon, fresh flowers changed.

clips.end_frame: Two lilies in separate paper sleeves, Hạ suppressing a smile.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ thân mật hơn, tươi tắn khi gặp lại
dialogue.text: Lần thứ hai ghé tiệm rồi, hôm nay vẫn lấy hoa ly trắng hả anh Sơn?

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm giãn ra, nhẹ nhàng hơn thường ngày
dialogue.text: Vẫn như cũ thôi Hạ, ngồi đây nghe mùi hoa dễ chịu hơn.

clips.lighting: Warm afternoon window light in the recent-past flower shop, no night grade.

cinematic.intent: Make the second visit feel like Hạ recognizing a pattern while giving Sơn room to deny it.
cinematic.composition: Match the prior table geometry with changed flowers and two separate wrapped lilies in view.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ places the second lily before he asks, withdrawing her hand rather than pushing it at him.
cinematic.performance: Her smile is suppressed, not coyly performed; his pause should reveal surprise at being remembered.
cinematic.focus: Keep her face and the separate sleeves at shared readable depth, no readable date cue required.
cinematic.texture: Fresh stems and different wrapping folds distinguish the afternoon without inventing a calendar insert.
cinematic.sound_detail: A bell tail and paper sleeve settle under her line, with ordinary outside traffic continuing.
cinematic.rhythm: Let recognition precede the teasing question, ending before Sơn supplies an unnecessary extra answer.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop. Hạ wears her cream linen dress, forest-green florist apron with pocket shears, intact pale-blue silk scarf around her neck, and silver hair clip pinned at the back of her hair.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ nhỏ nhẹ, quan tâm thật lòng
dialogue.text: Anh nhìn sảnh tòa nhà Vũ Kiên hai chiều rồi, bên đó có chuyện căng vậy?

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm lắng xuống, ánh mắt xa xăm
dialogue.text: Công việc cũ sắp kết thúc rồi, xong chuyện tôi không canh cửa nữa.

clips.lighting: Warm afternoon window light in the recent-past flower shop, no night grade.

cinematic.intent: Allow Hạ to notice the surveillance without turning the scene into an accusation.
cinematic.composition: Use the existing shoulder framing to follow her eyeline from Sơn toward the window and back.
cinematic.blocking: She looks once toward the lobby, returns to his face and simply waits.
cinematic.performance: Curiosity stays warmer than suspicion; Sơn's attention leaves the lobby reluctantly but completely for this beat.
cinematic.focus: Keep her eyes as the focus destination while the lobby remains only a contextual background shape.
cinematic.texture: Window reflections move softly across flower buckets; neither person touches a new object.
cinematic.sound_detail: No line is needed; let distant street noise expose the silence between their shared looks.
cinematic.rhythm: Make the outward glance short and the return longer, so the human connection wins the duration.

cinematic.intent: Make the third return an offered kindness that Sơn cannot explain as surveillance work.

cinematic.texture: Door glass and flower wrapping carry late light; no new flower is exchanged here.

scenes.purpose: Giới thiệu bằng chứng bị lấy và lịch giao hàng trong bảy ngày.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The meal container settling at the cabin door bridges to the flower-shop cash drawer. Do not replay the tin being closed.

clips.start_frame: Single dark-olive canvas backpack open on the cabin table.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Single dark-olive canvas backpack open on the cabin table), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: Sơn lays out the black ledger, a sealed tin and a concealed handgun case (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: His orderly hands contrast with fatigue in his shoulders; the narration should sound factual, not boastful, settling into the end state (Three separate objects on the table, bag empty beside them) as canvas creases, black leather and dented tin each have a different surface response to daylight.
clips.end_frame: Three separate objects on the table, bag empty beside them, Sơn's dark-olive canvas backpack resting open beside him.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng độc thoại trầm nghị, tập trung phân tích chứng cứ
dialogue.text: Trưa ngày thứ nhất tại chòi gỗ, tôi mở ba lô bày cuốn sổ đen, chiếc USB và hộp thiếc mà Rắn Đen đang truy lùng.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon daylight through cabin gaps, cooler shadows, no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Replace the quiet romantic memory with objects that reveal why Sơn cannot simply rest.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium frame to read the open bag and three separate items without a montage.
cinematic.blocking: He lays out ledger, sealed tin and closed case in distinct spaces, never stacking their identities.
cinematic.performance: His orderly hands contrast with fatigue in his shoulders; the narration should sound factual, not boastful.
cinematic.focus: Keep the tabletop and his lowered face at practical depth so the inventory remains one action.
cinematic.texture: Canvas creases, black leather and dented tin each have a different surface response to daylight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let three modest set-down sounds define the objects, with wind continuing through the cabin gaps.
cinematic.rhythm: Do not give each item an artificial reveal pause; the meaningful pause comes after the bag empties.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn's single unzipped dark-olive canvas backpack sits at the edge of the wooden cabin table beside the evidence items.

clips.start_frame: Black ledger open, USB taped inside the back cover.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Black ledger open, USB taped inside the back cover), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: He removes the USB and finds the matching dispatch receipt underneath (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: Fingers slow briefly when he recognizes the receipt, suggesting significance before the next line explains it, settling into the end state (USB and receipt placed side by side, ledger still open) as worn adhesive stretches slightly, and the receipt retains the crease from being stored under the drive.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng độc thoại điềm tĩnh, rõ ràng từng chi tiết
dialogue.text: Dưới lớp bìa da cuốn sổ đen là chiếc USB chứa tài khoản ngầm cùng tờ phiếu điều vận đóng dấu đỏ.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon daylight through cabin gaps, cooler shadows, no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Reveal a second layer of evidence through a believable physical discovery, not a screen animation.
cinematic.composition: The detail shot holds the back cover, taped USB and receipt in a single usable plane.
cinematic.blocking: He peels the existing tape, removes the USB and exposes the paper beneath without hiding either.
cinematic.performance: Fingers slow briefly when he recognizes the receipt, suggesting significance before the next line explains it.
cinematic.focus: Hold the object plane steady; readable layout matters more than legible handwritten words or digits.
cinematic.texture: Worn adhesive stretches slightly, and the receipt retains the crease from being stored under the drive.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use tape lift and paper separation as small clear sounds; no electronic chime belongs to an unplugged USB.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the receipt appear because the USB moves, then settle both side by side for the continuation.

screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế nhân vật và giữ nguyên hệ vật thể cố định (BLACK_BOOK, USB, TIN, RECEIPT, VIAL, GUN_CASE) trong không gian cố định tại giây 10.0s, chuyển động môi trường tiếp diễn tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon daylight through cabin gaps, cooler shadows, no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Turn the receipt into an external deadline while keeping its printed content visually unobtrusive.
cinematic.composition: Keep the exact preceding detail setup, USB and receipt still sharing the same table orientation.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn follows the existing sequence of boxes once, stopping at the ship stamp rather than tapping repeatedly.
cinematic.performance: The fingertip becomes firmer at the last box; his off-screen voice remains controlled rather than prophetic.
cinematic.focus: Retain the same focus plane as the receipt reveal, with the final box and stamp readable as shapes.
cinematic.texture: A curled paper corner shifts in the cabin breeze while his finger keeps the relevant area flat.
cinematic.sound_detail: One fingertip drag under the sentence, no added ticking or departing ship sound to overstate the clue.
cinematic.rhythm: The sentence earns the final stop; let the fingertip remain with slight live movement after the words.

clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Tin open, three sealed fictional Tê vials in fitted slots), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: He counts the intact seals, closes the lid without using anything (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: His hands show familiarity with the objects but no pleasure or curiosity about using them, settling into the end state (Sealed tin closed, three vials accounted for inside) as the dented lid and fitted lining look handled, while the sealed glass stays clean and ordinary.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng độc thoại lạnh và trầm khi nhìn ba ống thuốc trong hộp thiếc

clips.lighting: Present-day noon daylight through cabin gaps, cooler shadows, no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Introduce the sealed substance as evidence of a larger system, without fetishizing its use.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail composition to show all three fitted slots and the intact vial caps together.
cinematic.blocking: He checks the three seals in place and closes the tin lid once without removing a vial.
cinematic.performance: His hands show familiarity with the objects but no pleasure or curiosity about using them.
cinematic.focus: Keep seals and tin edge crisp, avoiding a macro liquid view that suggests an instructional demonstration.
cinematic.texture: The dented lid and fitted lining look handled, while the sealed glass stays clean and ordinary.
cinematic.sound_detail: Small glass restraint and a single lid click should be softer than the surrounding wind.
cinematic.rhythm: Count by a short eye or hand progression, then close with finality instead of another suspenseful reopening.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon daylight through cabin gaps, cooler shadows, no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn separating himself from violence while not pretending the past has vanished.
cinematic.composition: The medium setup keeps his empty hands and the beam recess within the same physical frame.
cinematic.blocking: He secures the complete closed case above the beam, then lowers both hands where they can be seen.
cinematic.performance: Avoid a triumphant resolve; he checks placement from habit and seems heavier once the hands return.
cinematic.focus: Keep enough depth to understand the recess, without exposing hidden contents or a new weapons insert.
cinematic.texture: Old timber, worn case leather and pale dust belong to the existing cabin, not an armory display.
cinematic.sound_detail: A restrained case-to-wood contact and his exhale are sufficient; never add a weapon-cocking sound.
cinematic.rhythm: Complete the placement once and end below the beam, allowing the absence from his hands to register.

clips.lighting: Recent-past garage at night, amber fluorescent practicals, moving search beams, no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Turn the trap into immediate physical pressure and damage the watch without making it an action trophy.

cinematic.focus: Keep his whole defensive movement readable, not a separate slow-motion watch impact or disorienting lens change.
cinematic.texture: Search beams move across existing concrete and car paint, leaving the concealed space readable at the end.
cinematic.sound_detail: One dull metal knock is swallowed by alarm and footsteps; no firearm discharge or impact on a body is added.
cinematic.rhythm: The duck is fast, the concealed breathing interval longer, leaving the chain tension as a consequence.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon sun, bright road outside cool stall and market shade.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s — Khóa góc quay & Vật thể cố định): Góc máy toàn cảnh (35mm anamorphic wide, f/5.6) — khóa toàn bộ không gian cố định, trục 180 độ và vị trí nhân vật tại bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương, nhân vật vào nhịp chuyển động ngay từ khung hình đầu tiên, chỉ tương tác xung quanh hệ vật thể cố định (MARKS, VIAL). screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế nhân vật và giữ nguyên hệ vật thể cố định (MARKS, VIAL) trong không gian cố định tại giây 10.0s, chuyển động môi trường tiếp diễn tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: One pursuer stepping around a pine, Sơn behind the trunk.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (One pursuer stepping around a pine, Sơn behind the trunk), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: Sơn takes his balance and pins his weapon hand without striking his head (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: His breath tightens with effort; the pursuer resists instead of instantly becoming a limp stunt prop, settling into the end state (Pursuer seated against the trunk, Sơn holding the wrist away) as sand shifts under their feet and rough bark catches clothing, grounding weight without graphic injury.
clips.end_frame: Pursuer seated against the trunk, Sơn holding the wrist away.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn choosing control over injury, while retaining the physical difficulty of stopping a pursuer.
cinematic.composition: The restrained handheld medium-wide keeps pine trunk, both bodies and the weapon hand readable together.

cinematic.performance: His breath tightens with effort; the pursuer resists instead of instantly becoming a limp stunt prop.
cinematic.focus: Hold the full defensive relation from one side, with no close-up describing a damaging joint technique.
cinematic.texture: Sand shifts under their feet and rough bark catches clothing, grounding weight without graphic injury.
cinematic.sound_detail: Short breaths, fabric tension and sand displacement replace exaggerated impact booms under his instruction.
cinematic.rhythm: Make contact and controlled descent one short struggle, then keep the restrained posture alive with visible effort.

dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm lạnh, ra đòn tự vệ gọn và dứt khoát
dialogue.text: Định dùng ống thuốc Tê đánh lén từ phía sau hả? Thứ thuốc của tụi mày không chạm được vào người tao đâu!

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Escalate from a controlled restraint to an unpredictable second threat, not a display of effortless mastery.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the same handheld setup, axis and existing body positions at the seam as the second man enters.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn reacts to the new reaching arm while staying aware of the first pursuer, ending with the device out of grasp.
cinematic.performance: Show surprise in his breath and shoulders; the second man overcommits rather than politely waiting for a move.
cinematic.focus: Retain the preceding useful depth and whole-arm readability, without a new device-application close-up or rack.
cinematic.texture: Loose sand and suitless field-jacket fabric carry the abrupt loss of balance through ordinary materials.
cinematic.sound_detail: A scuff, strained exhale and small object landing should dominate; no supernatural pulse announces Tê.
cinematic.rhythm: The new attack interrupts the held control, then the stumble ends the beat without repeating the previous takedown.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm vang lớn gọi vọng xuống chốt công an dưới đồi
dialogue.text: Công an dưới đường nghe rõ không! Trên đồi dương có kẻ bị dính chính ống thuốc gây liệt của hắn, cần bác sĩ ngay!

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: Make the decisive moral action a call for help after the opponent has become vulnerable.
cinematic.composition: The medium view includes Sơn kneeling, the fallen man's breathing torso and the conscious man kept separate.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn checks for visible breathing, keeps his distance from the dropped device and calls toward the known road.
cinematic.performance: His urgency is practical concern rather than guilt performed at camera; he does not admire the result.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn's mouth and the breathing patient readable, without graphic medical inspection or instructional detail.
cinematic.texture: Sand clings to clothing and the pine shadows continue moving, preventing the fallen figure from reading as dead.
cinematic.sound_detail: His clear request is close above breath and wind; no pulse monitor or clinic equipment is heard here.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the breathing observation a beat before the call, so care motivates the words rather than following them decoratively.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning, raking daylight between pines, natural sandy reflections.

cinematic.intent: End the action on Sơn accepting scrutiny, making cooperation a cost he consciously pays.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide tree-line view to connect stretcher arrival, the two attackers and Sơn's empty hands.
cinematic.blocking: He steps back once to give the stretcher room and stays where Mây can supervise him.

cinematic.focus: Hold the whole rescue arrangement clear, with no cut to a face that loses the patient positions.
cinematic.texture: Stretcher fabric, sand and field clothing stay practical; the morning sun does not become emergency-colored lighting.
cinematic.sound_detail: Approaching steps and stretcher handling merge with Mây's line, with the breathing thread ready for the clinic cut.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần. Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.

cinematic.performance: His line is calm practical attention; Mây absorbs the need for patience rather than demanding instant answers.
cinematic.focus: Keep both patient positions and the observing people legible, without an invented monitor display or intrusive medical close-up.
cinematic.texture: Green curtain folds and worn steel beds give the room lived-in restraint, not a glossy emergency ward.
cinematic.sound_detail: Continue the breathing thread from the dune into quiet ventilation and Linh's measured voice.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow a short observation before the line, then hold ongoing care rather than a dramatic pronouncement of survival.

dialogue.text: Chúng dùng thứ này khống chế con tin lên tàu không gây tiếng động.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Protect future suspense by refusing an exact recovery clock while keeping the doctor useful.
cinematic.composition: Frame Mây and Linh beside the closed curtain, with her note-taking hand visible in the medium shot.
cinematic.blocking: Linh answers without a demonstration; Mây crosses out only her tentative estimate and listens through the rest.
cinematic.performance: His firmness should be weary experience rather than a lecture, and her revision an acceptance of limits.
cinematic.focus: Keep their faces at the same readable depth; the crossed-out note remains a shape rather than an exposed medical number.
cinematic.texture: The green curtain shifts gently beside them while steady practical light keeps skin tones neutral.
cinematic.sound_detail: His measured voice sits over the ordinary clinic bed; do not add a countdown or rising pulse effect.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the warning enough room to be understood, then end on Mây changing the note instead of repeating the rule.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Bác sĩ Linh khoác áo blouse trắng sờn vai, cổ đeo ống nghe y tế, tay xách túi cấp cứu vải bố có sẵn bình trợ thở.

screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế nhân vật và giữ nguyên hệ vật thể cố định (VIAL, DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG) trong không gian cố định tại giây 10.0s, chuyển động môi trường tiếp diễn tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Thành beside the conscious attacker, Mây holding the evidence bag.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Thành beside the conscious attacker, Mây holding the evidence bag), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: The attacker recognizes the shipping emblem and stops answering (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: Mây asks plainly; the attacker stops answering through a tightened mouth, not a villainous laugh, settling into the end state (Attacker looking away from the bag, Thành noting the reaction) as the sealed bag catches plain window light; sheets remain disturbed from treatment, not staged like an interrogation set.
clips.end_frame: Attacker looking away from the bag, Thành noting the reaction.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ công an đanh thép hỏi cung ngay khi nghi phạm mở mắt
dialogue.text: Tỉnh rồi thì nhìn thẳng vào logo vận tải này và khai thật đi. Ai cử hai người mang thuốc Tê tới đồi dương tìm Sơn?

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, clinic window light with neutral practicals, green curtains.

cinematic.intent: Let a suspect's silence become evidence of recognition without pretending it is a full confession.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium framing to retain Mây's speaking face, Thành and the conscious attacker within supervised space.
cinematic.blocking: Mây shows the existing bag at the man's eyeline; Thành watches him turn away rather than pushing him upright.
cinematic.performance: Mây asks plainly; the attacker stops answering through a tightened mouth, not a villainous laugh.
cinematic.focus: Keep the questioner and the turning face readable, with the emblem secondary and never legibly lettered.
cinematic.texture: The sealed bag catches plain window light; sheets remain disturbed from treatment, not staged like an interrogation set.
cinematic.sound_detail: A slight wrapping rustle leads into the question, after which the man's withheld answer is allowed to be silent.
cinematic.rhythm: Avoid another forced question in the spare seconds; let Thành's quiet noting of the response close the beat.

cinematic.composition: The close-up stays on Mây listening, folder held low enough that its closure is visible.
cinematic.blocking: She hears the slip without interrupting and closes the existing folder only after the important words.
cinematic.performance: Her face narrows into a decision, not a sudden gasp; she does not mouth the off-screen man's sentence.
cinematic.focus: Hold the existing close-up plane on her eyes and speaking-rest mouth, with no reaction insert of the suspect.
cinematic.texture: Plain folder paper and her sun-lined face remain unadorned under the clinic's ordinary light.
cinematic.sound_detail: The suspect's off-screen voice is weak but intelligible, then a single folder closure settles the information.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the voice finish first; her delayed closure makes the finding feel processed rather than announced by a cut.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Đường Về
scenes.purpose: Hạ gieo kiến thức hải đăng và mục tiêu mở sạp hoa.

clips.start_frame: Hạ walking along the city pier, Sơn beside her.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Hạ walking along the city pier, Sơn beside her), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: She stops at a ferry's distant light and names her home town (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: Her tone warms at the name, while his attention turns from the ferry toward her face, settling into the end state (Both facing the water, ferry light far beyond) as warm pier lamps meet the last daylight, leaving ordinary rail wear and water movement visible.
clips.end_frame: Both facing the water, ferry light far beyond.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ dịu dàng, ánh mắt nhìn ra sông đầy hoài niệm
dialogue.text: Một tháng trước bên bến phà, nhìn đèn sông là em nhớ biển Hòn Sóng.

dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm ấm áp, lắng nghe Hạ tâm sự
dialogue.text: Ngoài đó có gì mà nhắc tới mắt em đều sáng lên vậy Hạ?

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ introduce her own home as a desired future, not simply information Sơn will later use.
cinematic.composition: The wide pier view gives both walkers and the distant ferry one shared direction across open water.
cinematic.blocking: She stops at the rail to name the town; he stops because she does, not because of a target.
cinematic.performance: Her tone warms at the name, while his attention turns from the ferry toward her face.
cinematic.focus: Keep the two figures and ferry light readable at wide depth without a separate scenic insert.
cinematic.texture: Warm pier lamps meet the last daylight, leaving ordinary rail wear and water movement visible.
cinematic.sound_detail: A low ferry horn stays distant enough to support, not overwhelm, her simple naming of home.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow walking to settle before the name, letting the pause feel like memory rather than a forced plot clue.

clips.start_frame: Hạ drawing a round tower in condensation on a railing panel.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Hạ drawing a round tower in condensation on a railing panel), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: She sketches a small maintenance hatch below the gallery (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: Her ease should be affectionate and slightly amused at the specificity; he listens without treating it as tactical briefing, settling into the end state (Her fingertip at the hatch sketch, Sơn watching) as moisture smears under her fingertip, making the rough little hatch imperfect and temporary rather than diagrammatically precise.
clips.end_frame: Her fingertip at the hatch sketch, Sơn watching.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ tự hào, ấm áp khi kể về người cha gác đèn
dialogue.text: Ba em từng canh ngọn hải đăng cổ trên vách đá Hòn Sóng. Từ nhỏ em đã thuộc lòng từng bậc thang sắt và cửa kỹ thuật.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Make knowledge of the lighthouse arise from a child's familiarity with a parent's work.
cinematic.composition: The medium composition keeps Hạ's face and the existing misted glass panel within the same reach.
cinematic.blocking: She draws the rough tower and hatch from habit while Sơn follows her finger, no blueprint performance.
cinematic.performance: Her ease should be affectionate and slightly amused at the specificity; he listens without treating it as tactical briefing.
cinematic.focus: Keep the finger sketch and faces within useful medium depth, never changing to a revealing macro map.
cinematic.texture: Moisture smears under her fingertip, making the rough little hatch imperfect and temporary rather than diagrammatically precise.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft fingertip drag and open-air water bed support her voice, with no ominous clue emphasis.
cinematic.rhythm: Let her drawing accompany the sentence, then stop before adding unnecessary arrows, routes or an invented floor plan.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ mộc mạc, gửi gắm ước mơ giản dị
dialogue.text: Em chỉ mong dành dụm đủ vốn để về mở một sạp hoa tươi nhỏ ngay cổng chợ cá Hòn Sóng, sống bình yên cạnh biển thôi.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ name a life she wants for herself, giving her more than a role as Sơn's escape fantasy.
cinematic.composition: Keep the same medium composition and focus plane while the photograph is put away within existing reach.
cinematic.blocking: She pockets the photograph and rests both empty hands on the rail, facing the town's imagined direction.
cinematic.performance: Her wish sounds modest and practical, with a small trace of pleasure at describing it aloud.
cinematic.focus: Maintain the same readable faces and hands, without a scenic cutaway illustrating a shop that does not yet exist.
cinematic.texture: Her pale scarf and worn rail catch soft light; the open hands replace the earlier information-bearing photo.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her sentence stays close against ordinary harbour sound, avoiding a sentimental swell that turns the wish into a prophecy.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the practical words finish before she looks at Sơn, giving him a chance to meet the life she has described.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop. Hạ wears her cream linen dress, forest-green florist apron with pocket shears, intact pale-blue silk scarf around her neck, and silver hair clip pinned at the back of her hair.

dialogue.text: Quấn kỹ vào cổ đi Hạ, gió ngoài bến phà về đêm lạnh lắm.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening city pier, warm lamps and last daylight, no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Make a small protective reflex intimate without confusing it with ownership of the scarf.
cinematic.composition: The close-up holds Hạ's face, the loose scarf end and Sơn's gloved hand within one plausible reach.
cinematic.blocking: Wind lifts the existing scarf; Sơn catches its end and returns the cloth to her hand immediately.
cinematic.performance: He is gentle without lingering possession, and her brief look acknowledges care rather than helplessness.
cinematic.focus: Keep the caught fabric and faces at useful close-up depth, never making the water an impossible sharp insert.
cinematic.texture: Blue silk moves lightly against black glove, its intact edge clear before the later torn-fragment scenes.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use fabric movement over the steady pier wind, not a splash or dramatic catch sound that did not occur.
cinematic.rhythm: The catch is quick and the release unforced; let the moment after he lets go carry the intimacy.

scenes.spatial_lock_en: FIXED SCENE 15 SPACE (City Passenger Ferry Pier Walkway): Single locked evening location across all 6 clips: wide concrete riverfront walkway, metal railing with glass wind panels, dark river water below, and distant warm ferry lights across the channel. Evening dusk and warm pier lamps.
scenes.fixed_objects_en: FIXED SCENE 15 OBJECTS (Clip 1–6): (1) Metal pier railing and glass wind panels; (2) Hạ's long intact pale-blue silk scarf (SCARF) lifting in the river breeze; (3) Hạ's small sketch pad showing the lighthouse service hatch and her old family photograph of Hòn Sóng; (4) Hạ's silver hair clip and green florist apron.

scenes.fixed_objects_vi: VẬT THỂ CỐ ĐỊNH XUYÊN SUỐT CẢNH 15 (Clip 1–6): (1) Lan can sắt và vách kính chắn gió bến phà; (2) Chiếc khăn lụa xanh nhạt nguyên vẹn (SCARF) bay nhẹ trong gió sông; (3) Tờ giấy vẽ cửa nắp kỹ thuật hải đăng và tấm ảnh cũ chụp quê biển Hòn Sóng của Hạ; (4) Kẹp tóc bạc của Hạ.

clips.start_frame: Mây unlocking the lighthouse's lower iron door, Sơn behind her.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Mây unlocking the lighthouse's lower iron door, Sơn behind her), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: She shows him the old service route and starts up the stairs (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: She moves with local familiarity rather than performing a tour; his pace is attentive, not nostalgic ownership, settling into the end state (Main door open, service hatch visible beside the stair base) as rusted paint, worn stair edges and sea-blown grass mark a used public building, not a mystical ruin.
clips.end_frame: Main door open, service hatch visible beside the stair base.

cinematic.performance: She moves with local familiarity rather than performing a tour; his pace is attentive, not nostalgic ownership.

cinematic.sound_detail: Key and iron latch introduce the local wind; the sentence stays practical above the threshold sound.
cinematic.rhythm: Finish entry and direction before the next gallery shot, leaving the door open where the endpoint requires it.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ trầm buồn pha chút tự trách trước hiên nhà cũ
dialogue.text: Căn nhà nhỏ của ba Hạ dưới chân đồi đóng cửa gần một tháng nay. Tôi cứ ngỡ nó bận bán hoa trên thành phố chưa về.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at sea cliff, fading daylight, lamp only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Let Mây place Hạ's absence inside a real home and a real friendship, not just Sơn's grief.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium gallery view to include both faces and her pointing direction toward the harbour houses.
cinematic.blocking: Mây identifies the house once while staying on her side of the rail, then looks back toward Sơn.
cinematic.performance: Her tone is matter-of-fact with held concern; his reaction should not claim he knows Hạ's home better than she does.
cinematic.focus: Keep faces primary and the house direction contextual, avoiding an impossible readable close-up of a distant address.
cinematic.texture: Salt-worn rail and low evening light hold the same coastal world, with no new memorial objects.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wind remains present but controlled under her short factual line, with distant harbour sound barely defined.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the pointing gesture establish the fact, then spend the remainder on what the unanswered absence means between them.

screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế nhân vật và giữ nguyên hệ vật thể cố định (DUTY_POUCH) trong không gian cố định tại giây 10.0s, chuyển động môi trường tiếp diễn tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

cinematic.texture: The ordinary phone sits briefly against weathered rail and khaki sleeve, not a glowing new clue display.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her short sentence rises clearly above wind; a soft phone-to-palm contact closes the beat.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the refusal come before the handover, so the phone feels like the consequence of changing his assumption.

scenes.title: Dũng Tới Biển
scenes.purpose: Dũng đe dọa bằng phần khăn còn lại, để lộ lệnh về thành phố.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The evidence-bag rustle bridges to two separated scarf pieces on the cabin table. Do not repeat Dũng laying it down.

clips.start_frame: Two black cars stopping outside the coffee stall.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Two black cars stopping outside the coffee stall), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: Dũng steps out, knocks one empty chair aside, asks after his men (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: He expects the place to yield before he speaks; Bảy remains in place without exaggerated fearless posturing, settling into the end state (Chair on its side, Bảy behind the counter) as dusty tires, scuffed chair legs and ordinary seafront light preserve the modest scale of the intrusion.
clips.end_frame: Chair on its side, Bảy behind the counter.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.tone: giọng nam gằn hung hăng, hất hàm hỏi dồn giữa quán nước
dialogue.text: Sáng ngày thứ tư tao đích thân xuống Hòn Sóng rồi đây ông già! Hai thằng đàn em tao gửi xuống hôm qua nằm đâu, nói mau!

clips.lighting: Present-day morning coastal sun outside, awning shade at the counter.

cinematic.intent: Let Dũng's entitlement disturb the town's ordinary order through one clearly visible trespass.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide street composition to keep both black cars, empty chair and Bảy behind his counter related.
cinematic.blocking: Dũng steps out and knocks only the empty chair aside, his men staying near their cars.
cinematic.performance: He expects the place to yield before he speaks; Bảy remains in place without exaggerated fearless posturing.
cinematic.focus: Keep the chair's path and standing bodies readable, avoiding a low-angle glorification of his size.
cinematic.texture: Dusty tires, scuffed chair legs and ordinary seafront light preserve the modest scale of the intrusion.
cinematic.sound_detail: A dry chair scrape briefly interrupts traffic and awning sounds, then his question takes the foreground.
cinematic.rhythm: The chair disturbance is quick and singular; let its awkward resting position persist as a problem someone must answer.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.tone: giọng ông lão miền biển cứng cỏi, không hề nao núng trước kẻ côn đồ
dialogue.text: Tụi nó nằm bên phòng khám có công an canh gác đàng hoàng đó. Chú muốn kiếm thì qua đồn mà hỏi, đừng quậy quán tui.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning coastal sun outside, awning shade at the counter.

cinematic.intent: Give Bảy a boundary he can hold without turning an elderly civilian into an action hero.
cinematic.composition: Frame the counter opening between Bảy's speaking face and Dũng's looming position in the public aisle.
cinematic.blocking: Bảy sets his existing glass down, points toward the clinic and stays across the staff entrance.
cinematic.performance: He is wary but firm, refusing access by ordinary ownership of his space rather than a threatening gesture.
cinematic.focus: Keep his face and the counter boundary in shared medium depth, leaving Dũng's size contextual rather than dominant.
cinematic.texture: The used counter edge and plain glass reinforce what Bảy is actually protecting, a working place.
cinematic.sound_detail: The glass landing precedes the line, then a short ordinary room pause keeps the threat human rather than musical.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the boundary hold after the sentence; do not make Dũng test it with an extra shove or repeat the question.

clips.start_frame: Two separate pieces of pale-blue cloth on the table.
clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Two separate pieces of pale-blue cloth on the table), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: Sơn aligns the torn edges without pretending they are repaired (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: His fingers hesitate at near contact, carrying longing that the factual line alone should not overstate, settling into the end state (Matched torn edges separated by a narrow gap) as different folds show how each piece was carried, while matching pale-blue weave ties them to one object.
clips.end_frame: Matched torn edges separated by a narrow gap.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm nghẹn lại khi ghép hai đầu khăn lụa rách khớp vào nhau

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, daylight through cabin window, shade on porch.

cinematic.intent: Let matching torn edges create stronger evidence while preserving what the cloth cannot tell them.
cinematic.composition: Use the locked detail setup to compare two pieces at the same scale, edges separated by a visible narrow gap.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn aligns the short fragment beside the long remainder and stops before pretending to mend them.
cinematic.performance: His fingers hesitate at near contact, carrying longing that the factual line alone should not overstate.
cinematic.focus: Keep the matching fibers and gap crisp, with no inserted image of the abduction or inner watch face.
cinematic.texture: Different folds show how each piece was carried, while matching pale-blue weave ties them to one object.
cinematic.sound_detail: Only cloth sliding over wood and his low off-screen sentence interrupt cabin wind.
cinematic.rhythm: Give recognition a quiet beat, then preserve the gap so emotional completion does not masquerade as physical repair.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng độc thoại trầm đanh theo vết khắc thứ tư trên khung cửa

clips.lighting: Present-day noon, daylight through cabin window, shade on porch.

cinematic.intent: Let the fourth tally register a new day of pressure without turning counting into a repeated ritual montage.
cinematic.composition: The medium view keeps Sơn, three existing marks and the shelf where the tool returns in one setup.
cinematic.blocking: He makes exactly one new mark, then places the tool away without re-cutting earlier lines.
cinematic.performance: His movement is more decisive than the first day's, but not angry enough to damage the whole frame.
cinematic.focus: Keep the total count readable alongside his body, avoiding another identical isolated carving close-up.
cinematic.texture: Fresh wood beside older pale cuts gives time a physical trace while noon light stays harsh and natural.
cinematic.sound_detail: One short scrape and shelf contact carry the action, with no recycled seven-day voice-over.
cinematic.rhythm: Do the work briskly and leave the completed four visible, using the remaining breath as resolve rather than padding.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm thì thầm dẫn đường giữa những dãy lụa tối
dialogue.text: Đi sát theo dãy kệ lụa hướng tay trái tôi nghe Mây. Két sắt nằm ngay sau bức bình phong gỗ phía bàn làm việc.

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night, warm shop practicals against cool alley spill.

cinematic.intent: Show intimate knowledge of the shop turning into vulnerability for both travelers.
cinematic.composition: Track along their established aisle, silk racks framing the screened safe at the far end.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn leads without searching; Mây keeps a clear route back to the rear exit.
cinematic.performance: His certainty is habitual, while her small checks reveal she refuses to inherit that certainty.
cinematic.focus: Keep the safe screen readable ahead of him, not a sudden focus reveal behind their backs.
cinematic.texture: Silk brushes close to the frame, narrowing the path without becoming dreamlike curtains.
cinematic.sound_detail: Soft shoe steps, rain outside and a single cloth brush carry the intrusion.
cinematic.rhythm: Let familiarity make the approach efficient; the waiting safe is the final image of confidence.

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night, warm shop practicals against cool alley spill.

cinematic.intent: Turn the search into a concrete gain before Bà Hai takes back the encounter.
cinematic.composition: Use one stable detail view that distinguishes red cloth ledger from the small metal token.
cinematic.blocking: His right hand takes the token, left arm receives the book, no rummaging through unrelated valuables.
cinematic.performance: Hands remain businesslike, stopping briefly at the token to verify it is the needed object.
cinematic.focus: Keep both acquired objects identifiable within the same focal plane and unchanged detail setup.
cinematic.texture: Steel safe edge, red cloth wear and token shape provide specific visual separation.
cinematic.sound_detail: An ordinary binding scrape and small token tap are enough; do not add a digital success chime.
cinematic.rhythm: Extraction happens once and ends with both objects secure, leaving no reset before the interruption.

dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm không hề nao núng, chắn trước Mây
dialogue.text: Má ngồi chờ sẵn vậy là tính gọi Dũng về vây bọn con sao?

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night, warm shop practicals against cool alley spill.

cinematic.intent: Reveal that their apparent intrusion has been an invitation controlled by Bà Hai.
cinematic.composition: Hold all three positions in the wide shot, safe behind Sơn and lit desk behind the turn.
cinematic.blocking: Both travelers turn toward the desk without advancing, leaving Mây aligned with the rear exit.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai is already settled, greeting them softly; their delayed recognition supplies the shock.
cinematic.focus: The lamp and her face become readable together without an internal cut or artificial zoom.
cinematic.texture: Warm desk light lands on violet silk, while cool alley spill still outlines the escape route.
cinematic.sound_detail: Lamp switch first, then her voice; do not accompany the reveal with a generic sting.
cinematic.rhythm: Allow one beat to identify her before the greeting, then hold the unequal stillness.

cinematic.intent: Show that preserving evidence now matters as much as escaping with it.

clips.action: 0.0–2.5s: From the starting position (Twenty-year-old Sơn outside a closed wooden door, new gloves tucked in his pocket), initiate the movement cleanly without hesitation. 2.5–6.5s: He hears an ordinary family sound inside and hesitates, knocking (performed once in real time without repeating the opening step). 6.5–10.0s: His hesitation is real calculation interrupted by a household sound, not a haunted retrospective pose, settling into the end state (Young Sơn's bare right hand just below the door knocker) as old paint, modest door hardware and rain beyond the stairs make the place lived in.

clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy night corridor, amber stairwell bulb and dim household spill.

cinematic.intent: Give the first crime moral weight through the ordinary life beyond a closed door.
cinematic.composition: Hold young Sơn, bare hand and door in the same wide corridor frame.
cinematic.blocking: He comes close enough to knock, then leaves his hand just short of contact.
cinematic.performance: His hesitation is real calculation interrupted by a household sound, not a haunted retrospective pose.

cinematic.texture: Old paint, modest door hardware and rain beyond the stairs make the place lived in.

cinematic.rhythm: Let the possibility of turning away exist before the knock is implied by the lowered hand.

cinematic.blocking: Thành keeps his seated body oriented to conceal civilian movement, Dũng facing the public road.
cinematic.performance: Fear shows in his breathing, but his eyes keep checking the useful exit rather than begging.
cinematic.focus: Keep the rear-door line perceptible to viewers without making Dũng turn and notice it.
cinematic.texture: Bent glasses and taut ties show the cost without adding bruises or fresh wounds.
cinematic.sound_detail: Dũng's threat is plain and near, with quieter civilian shuffling already behind the counter.

clips.wardrobe_note: Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder, cut steel cuff ring hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape. screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Dũng mặc áo thun đen sát nách, tai TRÁI đeo khuyên bạc hình chiếc đinh, đeo chéo túi vải bố đen dày đựng đồ nghề qua ngực, trên cổ tay PHẢI còn lủng lẳng chiếc vòng còng sắt bị cắt đứt xích từ hầm xe. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính tròn có gọng bên phải quấn băng keo trắng sau lúc bảo vệ dân ở quán nước, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly bên quầy cà phê.

dialogue.tone: giọng nữ dịu dàng pha chút linh cảm bất an trong đêm mưa tiệm hoa
dialogue.text: Đêm cuối trước biến cố ở tiệm hoa, anh đứng nhìn mưa ngoài cửa lâu vậy... Ngày mai anh còn quay lại đây với em không Sơn?

clips.lighting: Recent-past flower-shop night, warm bulbs, wet pavement street spill.

cinematic.intent: Give Hạ the power to leave an opening while asking for honesty instead of reassurance.
cinematic.composition: Use the shutter gap and counter in the wide composition, Sơn still on the inside edge.
cinematic.blocking: She stops the shutter halfway, then waits without walking toward him to fill the distance.
cinematic.performance: Her question is direct and tired of evasion, not a foreknowledge of coming tragedy.
cinematic.focus: Keep the unused opening visible alongside her face and his hesitation at the doorway.
cinematic.texture: Warm shop bulbs, wet pavement beyond and shutter slats make the possible departure tangible.
cinematic.sound_detail: Shutter rattle settles before the question, leaving the ordinary shop room tone.
cinematic.rhythm: Let the unclosed doorway hold the choice after she speaks, rather than filling it with movement.

cinematic.intent: Make an honest uncertain answer more intimate than another promise to return safely.

cinematic.sound_detail: Speak over a low steady street bed, no score instructing the audience to forgive him.
cinematic.rhythm: Give the first admission time to be heard, then the refusal to lie as a smaller second breath.

clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy evening, warm silk-shop lamps and cooler street rain.

cinematic.intent: Make the remembered kindness believable enough that rejecting Bà Hai later will hurt.
cinematic.composition: Match the region of empty young palms into the wide awning view, young Bà Hai already sheltered.
cinematic.blocking: She offers entry, he moves only as far as cover, without inventing childhood or extra possessions.
cinematic.performance: He is hungry and wary, she practical and attentive rather than visibly plotting a future crime.
cinematic.focus: Keep palms and their relative shelter readable, no impossible morph between old and young faces.
cinematic.texture: Rain-dark cheap clothes and the dry awning establish the immediate value of what she gives.
cinematic.sound_detail: Rain remains outside the shelter, her invitation direct and unornamented beneath it.
cinematic.rhythm: Let him hesitate before accepting cover, giving the kindness a small real cost in trust.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC_Y
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ mềm mỏng vừa gieo ơn nghĩa vừa trói buộc
dialogue.text: Cứ cầm đũa ăn cho no bụng đi đừng ngại. Ở cái thành phố này, không ai cho không ai thứ gì ngoài chỗ của cô đâu.

clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy evening, warm silk-shop lamps and cooler street rain.

cinematic.intent: Show the first permission to receive care before later gifts acquire obligations.
cinematic.composition: Keep the bowl and both young faces within the same medium table relation.
cinematic.blocking: She nudges the existing bowl nearer, withdraws her hands, he begins eating only afterward.
cinematic.performance: He watches for refusal before the first mouthful, while she lets him have the space.
cinematic.focus: Keep food and eyes readable without a sentimental insert of starving hands or oversized portions.
cinematic.texture: Steam and ordinary ceramic stand against the dry silk-shop interior and his damp sleeves.
cinematic.sound_detail: A bowl scrape and modest eating sounds play against rain, no warm sentimental music swell.
cinematic.rhythm: The wait before eating carries the change, then end after he accepts that she will not reclaim it.

scenes.spatial_lock_en: FIXED SCENE 43 SPACE (Hòn Sóng Harbour Apron under Floodlights & West Service Gate): Single contiguous dusk harbour space across all 6 clips: concrete harbour apron illuminated suddenly by high police floodlights in Clip 3 (Clips 1–5) and the lower lighthouse maintenance gate directly behind Kiên's white car on the west edge (Clip 6).

cinematic.intent: Keep the audience connected to Sơn's physical condition while the pursuit moves elsewhere.

clips.start_frame: Dũng behind a crate seeing the stretcher enter Bảy's van.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.tone: giọng nam nóng nảy đòi vượt dây cảnh giới sang xe cấp cứu
dialogue.text: Để tao qua xe coi thằng Sơn ra sao, tao không định hại chết nó!

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.tone: giọng nữ công an uy nghiêm chặn đứng Dũng
dialogue.text: Đứng lại ngoài vạch ngay Dũng! Bước thêm một bước là ăn còng!

clips.lighting: Early night, established harbour floodlight, warm van lamp, dim lighthouse practicals.

cinematic.intent: Establish how Dũng finds the van so his return feels earned and threatening.
cinematic.composition: Observe from behind his established crate, van path ahead and Mây turning from the pier.
cinematic.blocking: Dũng follows the visible stretcher route along the wall, staying on the same side of the lane.
cinematic.performance: His attention is fixed on reclaiming Sơn, while Mây's quick look shows she has noticed the approach.
cinematic.focus: Keep the path and both endpoints legible instead of obscuring everything in shallow darkness.
cinematic.texture: Crate edge stays a foreground boundary, floodlight spill fades naturally toward the protected rear lane.
cinematic.sound_detail: His boots soften near the wall, van sounds provide the direction he follows, no stealth-music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Let him commit to the route once; finish before confrontation so Mây's blocking action remains the next new beat.

Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder, cut steel cuff ring hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand.

clips.end_frame: Breathing visible, left hand still on the mattress.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.tone: giọng độc thoại nặng nhọc khi cơ thể còn tê liệt trên cáng
dialogue.text: Nằm trên đệm xe cứu thương, tai tôi nghe rõ từng tiếng bộ đàm báo Kiên đang lôi Hạ lên hải đăng mà bàn tay vẫn chưa nhấc lên nổi.

clips.lighting: Early night, established harbour floodlight, warm van lamp, dim lighthouse practicals.

cinematic.intent: Make helpless awareness replace the old fantasy that Sơn controls every situation.
cinematic.composition: Close on his face at mattress level, his bandaged LEFT fingers only at the lower edge if naturally framed.
cinematic.blocking: He attempts a small lift without moving the rest of his body; the hand settles where it began.
cinematic.performance: Eyes stay alert and frustrated, breath remains present, narration is internal with visible lips at rest.
cinematic.focus: Keep face and the nearest finger movement plausibly within the same shallow plane, no impossible eye reflection.
cinematic.texture: Warm van lamp reveals tired skin without corpse colouring, black collar retains the same damp creases.
cinematic.sound_detail: Breathing and low radio murmur support the single internal line, with no heartbeat countdown.
cinematic.rhythm: A genuine attempt occupies the take, followed by recognition of its failure; avoid repeated finger testing as padding.

scenes.purpose: Dựng song song chăm sóc Sơn và Hạ trì hoãn Kiên.

dialogue.tone: giọng nam trầm ngồi sau giữ chắc, mắt hướng lên đỉnh đèn
dialogue.text: Tôi giữ chắc đây, ánh đèn trên đỉnh tháp hiện rõ phía trước rồi.

clips.lighting: Night road lit by motorcycle headlamp, lighthouse work lights and low practicals inside.

cinematic.intent: Make the climb feel purposeful while preserving Sơn's limited condition and Mây's leadership.
cinematic.composition: Track laterally with the same motorcycle moving left to right uphill, no aerial detour.
cinematic.blocking: Mây holds a measured line, Sơn braces on the rear rail rather than leaning forward as a second rider.
cinematic.performance: His concentration appears in rigid shoulders and careful breathing; her attention remains on the road.
cinematic.focus: Keep both helmeted profiles and the road bend readable with the same tracking distance.
cinematic.texture: Existing headlamp supplies road light, dark sea remains below, no new rain or cinematic spray appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: The established engine note continues, joined by tires and wind, not a fresh chase-music track.
cinematic.rhythm: Maintain momentum through one visible bend, ending near the lighthouse approach without adding a near-crash.

cinematic.sound_detail: Engine ends cleanly, helmet contact and iron-door wind take over as local sounds.

cinematic.intent: Let every gained step show that Sơn is participating without pretending to be physically restored.
cinematic.composition: Track smoothly along the existing spiral route with Mây one step ahead and the rail continuously visible.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn uses the rail, stops at one step to steady himself, Mây waits and resumes with him.
cinematic.performance: He is frustrated by the delay but not theatrically collapsing; she reads the pause and stays calm.
cinematic.focus: Keep their changing height and the next landing in focus enough to follow, not alternating face inserts.
cinematic.texture: Bandage remains LEFT, black suit creases at the careful grip, no instant drying or costume change.
cinematic.sound_detail: Uneven but controlled steps echo against the stairwell, wind enters through existing slits.
cinematic.rhythm: One pause breaks the upward rhythm, then progress returns; do not repeat the hesitation at each stair.

cinematic.intent: Reward Hạ's concealed action by making the failed closure visible to her and the audience.
cinematic.composition: Frame Kiên testing the hatch medium, Hạ facing the inner sea wall within his control.
cinematic.blocking: Kiên tests the latch with RIGHT hand while keeping LEFT-hand gun low, then regrips Hạ LEFT upper arm before moving her upward.
cinematic.performance: Hạ watches without revealing satisfaction; Kiên interprets the resistance as old machinery, not a plotted trick.
cinematic.focus: Keep the narrow persistent gap readable, avoiding a new macro mechanism or a miraculous opening by itself.
cinematic.texture: The same clip prevents the same latch seating, paint and garment dust remain as established.
cinematic.sound_detail: One incomplete metal click and Kiên's impatient breath explain the failure without a narrator.
cinematic.rhythm: Let him try the closure only once, then force Hạ onward, leaving the ajar state for the following discovery.

clips.wardrobe_note: Hạ wears her plain grey cotton dress and thin sandals, scarf absent from neck, silver hair clip removed and wedged into the service hatch latch at 45.4. Kiên wears his white suit rumpled and damp with sea mist, luxury gold wristwatch glinting on his left wrist.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Hạ mặc váy vải cotton màu xám giản dị và đôi dép mỏng, cổ trống không còn khăn lụa, đã rút chiếc kẹp tóc bạc cài vào khe chốt cửa sắt từ cảnh 45.4. Vũ Kiên mặc bộ vest trắng đã xộc xệch và ướt sương gió biển khi tháo chạy lên tháp, cổ tay trái đeo đồng hồ vàng mặt sáng.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.tone: giọng nam trẻ thì thầm báo cáo qua bộ đàm ngay dưới nắp cửa sắt
dialogue.text: Báo cáo chỉ huy Mây, chị Hạ đã dùng chiếc kẹp tóc bạc chèn giữ nắp cửa phụ không bị khóa, tổ một đã áp sát ngay dưới sàn!

clips.lighting: Night road lit by motorcycle headlamp, lighthouse work lights and low practicals inside.

cinematic.intent: Make a tiny survival decision become an actual route for other people.
cinematic.composition: Hold the detail on the already ajar latch, an assisting hand reaching from below, Thành behind.
cinematic.blocking: The officer holds the hatch open after entry; Thành retrieves the existing clip once the first bodies have cleared the gap.
cinematic.performance: Their restraint contrasts with Kiên's earlier urgency, and Thành's report carries recognition rather than praise.
cinematic.focus: Keep clip and latch legible in one plane, with background bodies only as spatial context.
cinematic.texture: No new tool opens the hatch; the recovered clip stays in Thành RIGHT palm, not simultaneously still in the latch.
cinematic.sound_detail: Careful metal contact and low radio compression replace loud entry sounds that would contradict their quiet approach.
cinematic.rhythm: Begin with the gap Hạ left, complete one retrieval after clearance, end with hatch held open and clip safely recovered.
